description: This file defines the PersonDAO interface, which provides database access methods related to Person entities in the OpenMRS platform. It includes method signatures for retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying Person, Relationship, PersonAttribute, and related objects, as well as handling PersonMergeLog entries. The interface is used internally by the PersonService to abstract database operations.

classes.name: PersonDAO
classes.description: Interface defining database operations related to Person and associated entities in the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: getSimilarPeople
methods.description: Retrieves a set of Person objects that are similar based on name, birthyear, and gender criteria.

methods.name: getPeople
methods.description: Searches for persons matching a search phrase, with optional filtering by dead or voided status.

methods.name: savePersonAttributeType
methods.description: Persists a PersonAttributeType object to the database.

methods.name: deletePersonAttributeType
methods.description: Removes a specified PersonAttributeType from the database.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PersonAttributeTypes matching given criteria.

methods.name: getAllPersonAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all PersonAttributeTypes, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeType
methods.description: Fetches a PersonAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getPersonAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttribute by its ID.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Fetches a Relationship entity by its ID.

methods.name: getAllRelationships
methods.description: Returns all Relationships, optionally including voided ones.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Gets a RelationshipType by ID.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypes
methods.description: Retrieves RelationshipType objects matching given criteria.

methods.name: savePerson
methods.description: Persists a Person object to the database.

methods.name: deletePerson
methods.description: Deletes a Person from the database.

methods.name: getPerson
methods.description: Fetches a Person by ID.

methods.name: saveRelationship
methods.description: Saves a Relationship object to the database.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Deletes a Relationship.

methods.name: getRelationships
methods.description: Retrieves relationships involving specified persons and optional relationship type and date range.

methods.name: saveRelationshipType
methods.description: Persists a RelationshipType object.

methods.name: deleteRelationshipType
methods.description: Removes a RelationshipType.

methods.name: getPersonByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Person entity using its UUID.

methods.name: getPersonAddressByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAddress entity by UUID.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttribute entity by UUID.

methods.name: getPersonName
methods.description: Gets a PersonName by its ID.

methods.name: getPersonNameByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonName by UUID.

methods.name: getRelationshipByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a Relationship using its UUID.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a RelationshipType by UUID.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a PersonAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: getSavedPersonAttributeTypeName
methods.description: Retrieves the current database value of a PersonAttributeType's name, bypassing caches.

methods.name: getSavedPersonAttributeTypeSearchable
methods.description: Retrieves whether a PersonAttributeType is marked as searchable in the database.

methods.name: getAllRelationshipTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all RelationshipTypes, including retired ones if specified.

methods.name: savePersonMergeLog
methods.description: Persists a PersonMergeLog record.

methods.name: getPersonMergeLog
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonMergeLog by ID.

methods.name: getPersonMergeLogByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonMergeLog by UUID.

methods.name: getAllPersonMergeLogs
methods.description: Returns all PersonMergeLog records.

methods.name: getWinningPersonMergeLogs
methods.description: Retrieves logs where the specified person was the winner in merge.

methods.name: getLosingPersonMergeLogs
methods.description: Retrieves logs where the specified person was the loser in merge.

methods.name: savePersonName
methods.description: Saves a PersonName.

methods.name: savePersonAddress
methods.description: Saves a PersonAddress.
